picks.editorial_note: A purported AI-generated proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, one of mathematics' oldest unsolved problems, would be a landmark moment for AI-assisted discovery if it holds up to continued scrutiny — a qualitatively different kind of result from incremental AI applications.
picks.title: AI Takes on the Riemann Hypothesis: What Does It Mean for the Future of Mathematics?

picks.editorial_note: The $500 million Empire AI Research Computing Center breaking ground at Buffalo represents one of the largest state-backed AI infrastructure investments in the country, positioning New York as a major public AI compute hub.
picks.title: Officials break ground on Empire AI’s permanent home at UB

picks.editorial_note: A $25 million gift from the Lilly Endowment to fund Indiana University's AI learning ecosystem is a major philanthropic bet on integrating AI across higher education at scale.
picks.title: Indiana University receives $25M from Lilly Endowment to drive AI innovation

picks.editorial_note: A $12M DOE Genesis Mission award pairs Harvard-led quantum error-correction research with AI, exemplifying the deepening federal push to fuse quantum computing and AI in frontier science.
picks.title: Harvard-led team wins $12M to advance quantum computing with AI — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's co-leadership of the EDITH trial — the world's largest AI-assisted breast cancer screening study, enrolling nearly 700,000 women — is a rare case of AI diagnostic tools being validated at population scale with real clinical stakes.
picks.title: Cambridge co-leading world’s largest trial to use AI to help detect breast cancers earlier

picks.editorial_note: Winning the ACM Gordon Bell Prize, high-performance computing's top honor, for an AI system that reinvents climate data assimilation signals genuine scientific advancement in using generative AI for climate modeling.
picks.title: Research team with FSU ties wins 2026 ACM Gordon Bell Prize for Climate Modelling

picks.editorial_note: A UCLA-co-authored Nature Sustainability study quantifying AI data centers' outsized electricity draw adds hard evidence to the policy debate over AI's energy footprint and grid impact.
picks.title: These U.S. data centers use four times the power used in LA

picks.editorial_note: A DARPA-funded project to build verifiable AI trust guarantees by combining machine learning with formal logical reasoning speaks directly to a core policy and safety challenge facing AI deployment.
picks.title: NMSU receives DARPA award for solution to AI trust issues

picks.editorial_note: Aalto's coordination of Finland's new FCAI-X national AI flagship center reflects a coordinated government-academia strategy to concentrate AI research investment at the national level.
picks.title: Aalto coordinates new AI research flagship and is involved in four others | Aalto University

picks.editorial_note: Texas Tech's partnership with AVX Defense Technologies under the U.S. Army's FleetSpace program shows AI decision-making platforms moving into active defense modernization programs.
picks.title: Texas Tech
